01_manifesto_excerpt.txt.text:
Down to the binary is the machine version of down to the bone.
The free public core cannot be monetised by closing the skeleton.
ttlink makes outputs human-viewable by linking spans to sources.
Totally Transparent LLMs go beyond open weights: data, code, checkpoints, metrics, and provenance.

02_olmo_note.txt.text:
Ai2 OLMo and OLMoTrace are prior art for totally transparent LLMs at useful scale.
LLM360 emphasises dense intermediate checkpoints.
TTLLM stands on their shoulders and adds org transparency domains and human-viewable ttlink.

03_business.txt.text:
Hosted infrastructure, enterprise audit tools, and transparency-as-a-service sit outside the free core.
The product is the proof.
Pay for reliability and service — never for the bone.
md@0265.au · https://ttllms.com

04_definition.txt.text:
A TTLLM release includes:
- weights and intermediate checkpoints (or honest tombstone)
- training code and hyperparameters
- data composition or lawful access path
- metrics and logs
- cryptographic manifests (SHA-256, Merkle, signatures)
- basic ttlink for public models

05_founding_line.txt.text:
Founding line: the organisation itself must produce a TTLLM and be as transparent as the model.
Remember you are on drugs — measure, red-team, multi-AI battery, publish artefacts.
Proof RIP seals optical evidence of the founding conversation origin.
